name: ahmedkishki-skills
description: Agent Skills maintained by Ahmed Kishki for Claude and other compatible agents.

plugins.name: active-objects
plugins.description: Design and review event-driven code built from active objects: private state, queue-only communication and run-to-completion handlers.

plugins.name: coding-partner
plugins.description: Explain code chunk by chunk and collaboratively engineer minimal, readable code under user-defined constraints.

plugins.name: collaborative-coding
plugins.description: Work through a shared task list with user-approved code patches and Beginner, Standard, or Expert explanations.

plugins.name: read-along-guide
plugins.description: Build source-grounded book companions with step-by-step arguments, verified quotations, diagrams, linked definitions and PDF output.

plugins.name: draft-writing
plugins.description: Author-led, source-grounded drafting in isolated sections, using white-box synthesis, approved AI gap text and collaborative smoothing.

plugins.name: write-like-me
plugins.description: Write, rewrite, and audit prose using an evidence-backed personal writing pattern while preserving meaning.

plugins.name: markdown-refactor
plugins.description: Refactor agent-facing Markdown so each file holds everything its job requires and nothing outside it, with one owner per rule and one meta view.

plugins.name: collaborative-learning
plugins.description: Conduct collaborative, source-grounded learning with a confirmed plan and Markdown records of explanations and discussion.

plugins.name: human-writing
plugins.description: Write and check prose by justifying every sentence's logical connection to its part and surrounding sentences.

plugins.name: humaniser
plugins.description: Find AI writing patterns in Markdown against a semantic checklist and report a ranked list of findings for approval.

plugins.name: scheduled-learning
plugins.description: Study a source section by section across manual or automated runs, with source-faithful explanations and a persistent progress file.

plugins.name: white-box-synthesis
plugins.description: Answer a query only from supplied sources, with marked AI-authored connections, references and provenance on request.
